title: Inside A Massive Data Center Convention
content:
A few weeks ago I traveled to northern VA to report on the biggest data center developer convention in the U.S.

I wanted to speak to the people actually building the data centers about what they felt like the public was misunderstanding about their industry, and see first hand what it was like in the neighborhoods nestled in between dozens of data centers in VA’s “data center alley”.

I know some people are going to get triggered just hearing from these data center developers, but I do thing what they had to say was revealing. They definitely are aware of how hated they are and it seems like they recognize things need to change.

The video I made with Soon (a new tech media company) is out now!! Please watch it and leave a comment.
